briefdescription.para: Quality gate tests for the wiki RAG retrieval path.

detaileddescription.para: Tests: WISQ-01: Recall@5 on an inline synthetic reference collection WISQ-02: Latency gate — query 100-chunk JsonWikiIndexReader in < 200 ms WISQ-03: Score monotonicity — results are sorted descending WISQ-04: min_score threshold filters low-relevance results WISQ-05: WikiRagSource pipeline integration with JsonWikiIndexReader
All tests use JsonWikiIndexReader (no RocksDB dependency).
